title: T7_INSERT 41.0 x 9.0: U505 TPS2553DRVR VBUS key in the T7 cable, S24 header J514, wire pads J515-J517
note: W2 PCB-SB2. One-sided in-cable board under heat-shrink: the cut VBUS conductor of the T7 USB3 cable lands on J515 (from the Q6A J5) and J516 (to the T7), J517 taps the uncut GND, J514 takes S24 (EN_T7, 3V3_Q6A, GND). The VBUS copper is scripted 0.8 mm; U505's exposed pad has two thermal vias to the bottom pour (IO-01 TJ <= 105 C at 1.5 A: model in build/15). The board keeps the 9.0 width and 8.5 height of the MECH-5 reserve but is 41.0 long, not 21.5 (OPEN for the mechanical lineage). CI/model output only; not a fabrication release; the bench gates (T-gates, USB3 link with the insert, TJ) stay OPEN.

heights_note: C516 16SVPC150M L6.9 (parts DB); J514 = mechanical/params/parts.json harness_headers PH_side 4.8; wire pads 1.5 = solder joint of the cut 20 AWG conductor (assumption); U505 WSON 0.8, 0603/0805 parts <= 0.95/1.35 (assumptions until the part heights are read)
